normalized_text:
We're hiring an SDE II for our platform team.

Location: Remote (India)

REQUIREMENTS
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience building web applications.
Proficiency in JavaScript, ReactJS and Node.js.
Comfortable working with MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases.
A degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES
- Build and maintain customer-facing features
- Own a service end to end, from design to deployment
- Mentor junior engineers on the team

NICE TO HAVE
- familiarity with GraphQL, exposure to CI/CD pipelines.
